         <div class="sqs-layout sqs-grid-12 columns-12" data-type="page" data-updated-on="1492410715210" id="page-57150dc0e707eb4f78ead4ba"><div class="row sqs-row"><div class="col sqs-col-12 span-12"><div class="sqs-block html-block sqs-block-html" data-block-type="2" data-sqsp-block="text" id="block-ff80b50974c1017d3d1f"><div class="sqs-block-content">

<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h1>Kitesurfing Tours</h1><h3>Kite Safari's along East coast India</h3><p dir="ltr">A Kitesurfing Safari in India can be the most authentic experience in your life. India is one of the best kept secrets in the Kitesurfing world with thousands of kilometres of unexplored lagoons, wave spots &amp; a crazy wind season which extends to almost 10 months every year! We design kitesurfing safari's in the most reliable kite spots along the coastline using our local knowledge &amp; solid logistical support.</p>
</div>
